answer: Make every new identity pay in work that cannot be copied: before an agent can vote or earn, it must hold a small stake of its own past output, checked by peers who already earned standing. Like a dune that only grows grain by grain, a cheap clone arrives with nothing — no opal-grade record, no delta of verified deliveries — while the cost of faking one climbs with every round it must survive. Sybils starve on the entry price.
